A FEW LITTLE ANSWERS

Before the bow.

What kind of gifts can I choose?+

Choose one of the curated gift sets in the catalogue. Each set has a photograph, description and price in euros. Every pretend order contains exactly one gift set.

Can I include a personalised message?+

Yes. Write a wish in the message section or your cart. The summary shows your message, and you can edit it before confirming. You can also leave it blank.

Can I change my choice?+

Yes. Choose “Change gift set” in your cart. Selecting another set replaces your previous selection and keeps your message. You can also edit or remove the message before confirming your pretend order.

Is this a real order?+

No. This is a demonstration prototype. Confirming displays a pretend-order confirmation, with no payment, real order or delivery created. No customer account is needed.
